items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: That's how I met Mr. Robichill, Professor Robichill.

ctx.x: My brother Paul played the drums and I had the trumpet. And we visited all the joints of the district. We played with the Negro bands. I could buy them a little shell of beer for a nickel apiece and I was always welcome, John, because they liked the way I played. And it didn't hurt me. I listened to them play, they listened to me. They didn't play my way, but nobody threw us out. And he'd slap that bass and my brother would beat hell out the drums and we'd have a hell of a little bit of a time. And I was welcome.…
